verdict.rationale: First-party docs show the Admin API can programmatically read and change property data-retention settings, and a dedicated User Deletion API deletes Analytics data, so both retention and deletion are controllable through APIs an AI-native workflow can drive. Both capabilities appear only as one-line doc mentions. missing for 10: detail on retention period options and deletion scope/latency, evidence of whether the official MCP server exposes these controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
